remaining.A8_cochannel_-10dB.authenticated_deliver: Production provides AES-CTR plus CRC, with no AEAD authentication or authentication-failure counter.
remaining.A8_cochannel_-10dB.no_corrupt_messages: With a co-channel interferer at -10 dB SIR, the message sink receives payloads outside the expected source stream; authenticated delivery is not implemented.

remaining.C2_24000_acquire_0dB.acquired: At the requested low SNR, the receiver detects the preamble but loses lock without validating a header.
remaining.C2_24000_acquire_3dB.acquired: At the requested low SNR, the receiver detects the preamble but loses lock without validating a header.
remaining.D3_auction_flood.no_starvation: Policy conflict: strict bid priority permits starvation during an endless higher-bid flood; Adam rejected increasing priority with age. No cross-key expiry/decay interval is approved.
remaining.D6_crypto_errors_replay_restart.authenti: Production provides AES-CTR plus CRC, with no AEAD authentication or authentication-failure counter.
remaining.D6_crypto_errors_replay_restart.no_nonce: Restarting the production AES-CTR generator with the unchanged key and default counter repeats its keystream.
remaining.D6_key_rotation.rotation_supported: No coordinated mid-stream key-rotation and old-key retirement contract is exposed.

D3_auction_flood.no_starvation.before: A sustained high-bid flood starves offered lower-bid instruments; the auction has no starvation prevention.
D3_auction_flood.no_starvation.after: Policy conflict: strict bid priority permits starvation during an endless higher-bid flood; Adam rejected increasing priority with age. No cross-key expiry/decay interval is approved.
